title: Fix phase-close gate diff instructions (Codex HIGH from pl-a703)
description: Codex phase-gate review of pl-a703 flagged HIGH: PILOT-SESSION-GUIDE.md (Codex Phase-Gate section) and PHASE-2-COMPLETE.md tell operators to use `gh pr diff <pr>` / `git diff main...HEAD`, which only show the gate PR once earlier phase PRs are merged to main, so an operator could pass the gate without reviewing the accepted artifacts. Fix: pin the pre-phase base (git diff <pre-phase-sha>..HEAD) or explicitly diff all phase PRs. Source: Codex exec review 2026-06-09.

title: Raise/disable plan-run merge-timeout for human-gated phase-close gates
description: pl-a703 plan-run marked failed (child_pr_merge_timeout) even though all 3 PRs merged correctly. Default 30-min per-child merge window is too short for a phase-close seed needing human-approved Codex review; artifacts + seeds completed fine, only coordinator terminal state affected. Fix for human-gated plan-runs: set WARREN_PLAN_RUN_MERGE_TIMEOUT_MS=0 (or larger) on the server before dispatch, or auto-merge non-gate seeds. Validated 2026-06-09 via pl-a703 (first end-to-end coordinator run).
